title: Non-toxic total nitrogen determination using a low alkaline persulfate digestion
author: Studt, Campbell, et al.

steps.title: Dry forage samples
steps.instruction: Collect forage samples and dry them in an oven at approximately 60 °C for at least 24 h, or until the mass no longer changes.

steps.title: Weigh and extract dried forage
steps.instruction: Weigh 1.0 g of dried forage into a 25 mL Erlenmeyer flask (Kimble™ KIMAX™ Narrow Mouth Erlenmeyer Flasks or equivalent), add 20 mL distilled water, and boil for a total of 20 min ensuring the samples do not boil dry.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 1.0 g dried forage into flask
Boil for 20 min without allowing samples to dry

steps.title: Recover extract and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Transfer the boiled extract to a labeled 15 mL Falcon™ tube, press through a garlic press to recover as much extract as possible, then centrifuge at 5 k × g for 10 min; collect the supernatant into a 10 mL volumetric flask, leaving the pellet behind.

steps.title: Adjust extract volume
steps.instruction: Bring the supernatant volume to exactly 10.0 mL with distilled water, resulting in a concentration of 0.1 g mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Dilute extracts for digestion
steps.instruction: Dilute the 0.1 g mL⁻¹ extract 10‑, 100‑, or 1000‑fold using a volumetric flask to obtain the appropriate concentration for the digestion reaction.

steps.title: Add alkaline persulfate digestion solution
steps.instruction: Add 1.0 mL of alkaline persulfate digestion solution to the diluted extract; the concentration will become 0.083 g mL⁻¹, which is used for calculating ppm N per gram of forage sample.

steps.title: Prepare water samples
steps.instruction: Pipette 5 mL of water sample, mix with 1.0 mL of digestion solution, and dilute with HPLC‑grade water as needed to fall within the nitrate reductase assay working range of 0.5–10 mg N L⁻¹.

steps.title: Prepare nitrate‑N 1000 ppm standard
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.44 g potassium nitrate (KNO₃; Research Organics, Catalog No. 12011) in 200 mL HPLC water to make a 1000 ppm nitrate‑N stock solution.

steps.title: Generate working standards
steps.instruction: Dilute the 1000 ppm stock to 10 ppm using a volumetric flask (prepare daily), then further dilute to produce a series of standards ranging from 0.05 ppm to 5.00 ppm (seven data points).

steps.title: Digest or leave standards undigested
steps.instruction: For each working standard, prepare two aliquots: add 1.0 mL alkaline persulfate digestion solution to one aliquot (digested) and add 1.0 mL distilled water to the other (undigested); both sets will be analyzed by the nitrate reductase assay.
